title: Phone executor: ticket claim and fill inside the foreground service (no bring-to-front) -- only after 24 h of clean background heartbeats
note: [2026-10-14 weekly planning] OPERATOR-APPROVED 2026-10-14 (Tier-2, prop execution path), GATED: start only after the PHONE-AUTOLOGIN-2 APK shows 24 h of clean background heartbeats. Source: PI-20261010-UYZJSGJY-0001 -- login checks, re-login and the account read already run in BgWeb; tickets still bring MainActivity forward, which Android background-activity-start limits can refuse (MEASURED 2026-10-10 'bring-to-front already requested'). Build: move pending peek + claim + fill into the foreground service; the dry-test ticket path (PHONE-DRYTEST-ACTION) is the verification, then one real ticket observed in the prop journal. [2026-10-15 lane] Dispatched by manager session_01VduHYzdaXe27wTDBLSu8ao on the operator's 2026-10-15 ~06:20Z choice 'Phone fills in background' (this supersedes the 24 h heartbeat gate in the note above; the gate was not re-measured by this lane). BUILT on claude/phone-fgs-exec (held until #18158, BREAKOUT-SL-AMEND-CLICK, merged): every ticket page call goes through one Page (cur) -- the kiosk, or the BgWeb overlay engine while a background ticket runs; backgroundTick routes a waiting ticket to bgJob(ticket=true) -> account terminal on the engine page -> the SAME claimAndRun/execute/executeAmend (gates, read-back, server verify, go-token unchanged). Fallback, never a halt (BgTicket): no engine / 2 no-answers -> bring-to-front; logged in but no terminal -> front for this ticket, engine retried after 10 min; a claimed background ticket ending refused/unconfirmed/mid-fill (amend refusals excepted while the sheet edit is unmeasured) -> front for 6 h, one bg_ticket_fallback event (pinged). Reports/events carry '(bg:<engine>) '; heartbeat bg_tickets/bg_ticket_last/bg_ticket_off_min (server allowlist added). UNMEASURED RISK: typeKeys (the key-event fallback when the native setter does not hold) into the non-focusable overlay window; the native setter is tried first, and a miss refuses fail-closed. Tests: BgTicketTest 6/6 (JVM), tests/test_phone_executor.py 62 passed; the APK compile is CI's.
